 Tube   select a profile to run firefox                                                             
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Profiles — ↑↓ jk: move · enter: run · a: add · e: open · d: delete · ?: keys · q: quit            
  Add: the folder — ↑↓: move · enter: open · backspace: folder above · tab: fields · esc: back      
  Add: the fields — tab: complete · ↑↓: field · space: all files · enter: add · esc: back           
  Profile — r: rename · u: user · p: forget password · n: DNS · t: edit · d: delete · enter: run ·  
  esc: back                                                                                         
  Login — tab ↑↓: field · space: remember · enter: connect · esc: back                              
  Connecting — esc: cancel                                                                          
  Status — tab shift+tab: tabs · q: quit · ?: keys                                                  
  Output — tab shift+tab: tabs · pgup pgdn: scroll · home: oldest · end: follow · other keys: go to 
  the application                                                                                   
  Network — ↑↓ jk: move · tab shift+tab: tabs · enter: use · x: disconnect · q: quit · ?: keys      
  Field — enter: save · esc: cancel                                                                 
  Menu of a field — enter: paste · esc: close                                                       
  Question — y: yes · n esc enter: no                                                               
  Keys — any key: close                                                                             
  Mouse — click: select, or press the key or the button under it · double click: open, run or use · 
  wheel: scroll · right click in a field: a menu to paste · drag: select text and copy it · shift   
  and drag: select as your terminal does                                                            
                                                                                                    
Tube runs one application through a VPN, and only that application: nothing else of the machine uses
it.                                                                                                 
Without the VPN the application has no network at all: Tube never lets it use the machine's.        
A program that hands its work to one that already runs (a second firefox, a terminal's server) is   
not in the VPN.                                                                                     
                                                                                                    
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                                                                                                    
any key close
